# Brian Phan

> I am a software engineer with multiple years of experience working on B2B and open source platforms. Currently I am one of the lead developers for OregonFlora, an open source botany research platform for Oregon State University. It is used statewide for information on conservation of plant diversity. I leverage Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode to work on my app, and I enjoy building a fully working solution and owning a problem. I see every challenge as a chance to discover something new. Blog covers software engineering and AI projects, cooking, life, photography, and film (103 posts).

## About

- [About Me](https://bachsofttrick.github.io/about): work experience, skills, education.
- [Projects](https://bachsofttrick.github.io/projects): AI and software projects.
